enchantment.alterna.heroism.desc: Increases damage at high (>75%) or low (<25%) HP. Reflects status effects on critical hits.
enchantment.alterna.deferred.desc: Converts direct attack damage into 10 damage-over-time installments over 2.5 seconds.
enchantment.alterna.detonation.desc: Every 5 hits triggers a fiery shockwave explosion dealing 6 damage.
enchantment.alterna.stormbreaker.desc: Allows throwing the weapon like a Trident, striking lightning and returning on impact.
enchantment.alterna.curse_of_drowned_cap: Grants up to +12 damage based on mineral stacks. | Taking damage loses random minerals and damage bonus.
enchantment.alterna.curse_of_rejection.d: Blocking knocks back attackers. | Recovers with a 2.5s cooldown at the cost of 1 true HP.
enchantment.alterna.curse_of_bloodlust.d: Grants +3 attack damage, | but missing a swing deals 2 hearts of true damage.

Grants Regen I and effect immunities, | but increases incoming damage by 10% and inflicts Insanity.
enchantment.alterna.chilling.desc: Chill for foes. Applies Bottom Freeze | once enough stacks have been applied.
enchantment.alterna.elastic.desc: Opponents are pulled towards you on hit.
enchantment.alterna.gluttony.desc: Steals saturation and nutritional from those you hit.
enchantment.alterna.vampirism.desc: Your weapon attacks drain health | from your foes and replenish your blood.
enchantment.alterna.wild.desc: On hit, deal 60% of your weapon's damage in an AoE.

item.alterna.scanner.tooltip: Hold right-click on a creature or plant to scan it
scanner.alterna.cragback.title: Cragback
scanner.alterna.cragback.text: Cragback. A massive herbivore that grazes the Lichen Savanna in loose herds. Its hide is armored with plates of mineral-hard keratin, which it sheds as it grows, and which can be collected without harming the animal. Cragbacks are docile, but will lower their horn and charge anything that wounds them. Recommendation: do not provoke the herd.
scanner.alterna.tetra.title: Tetra
scanner.alterna.tetra.text: Tetra. A four-winged flier native to the deep rift. All four of its limbs have evolved into wings, which double as legs on the ground and as grappling hooks on sheer cliff faces. Tetras hunt fish in shallow ponds and pluck ripe berries, carrying them in the beak. They are not hostile, but an entire colony will defend its nests.
item.alterna.overlord_grapple.tooltip: Hold right-click: hook a wall and reel yourself in
scanner.alterna.armor_overlord.title: Armor Overlord
scanner.alterna.armor_overlord.text: Warning. Apex predator detected. Armor Overlord. A towering arachnid that carries a fungal carapace on four arching legs, and hunts anything that moves. The cap deflects blades and arrows, and attacks from above are useless. Its weak point is the glowing neural cluster beneath the brim. It hunts by sight alone. Its field of view is narrow, and it turns slowly. Recommendation: stay out of its sight, crouch, and circle behind it. Then strike the brain from below. If it spots you, break line of sight and hide. It will soon give up the search.
scanner.alterna.tetra_nest.title: Tetra Nest
scanner.alterna.tetra_nest.text: Tetra nest. Woven from dry lichen and fine roots on high ledges. A Tetra lays up to three eggs in each nest. Tending the eggs may cause the hatchlings to imprint on you. Warning: disturbing a nest will provoke every adult Tetra nearby.
scanner.alterna.climbing_zombie.title: Climbing Zombie
scanner.alterna.climbing_zombie.text: Anomaly detected. A reanimated humanoid adapted to vertical terrain. It scales the rift walls to reach prey that believes itself safe above. Hostile. Avoid lingering on narrow ledges.
scanner.alterna.weavecap.title: Weavecap
scanner.alterna.weavecap.text: Weavecap. A giant fungus whose stem is formed from dozens of roots braided together into a single trunk. Its broad cap shelters the savanna floor from the falling mist. The woven wood is both strong and flexible, and is well suited to construction.
scanner.alterna.lichen_grass.title: Lichen Grass
scanner.alterna.lichen_grass.text: Lichen grass. Not a true grass, but a symbiotic colony of fungus and light-harvesting microbes. It thrives in the dim glow of the rift, and gives the savanna its distinctive crimson color. It is the primary food source of the Cragback.
scanner.alterna.ember_cap.title: Ember Cap
scanner.alterna.ember_cap.text: Ember cap. A small, glowing mushroom that grows in clusters on the savanna floor. Its bioluminescent compounds sharpen the eye's sensitivity to low light. Consumption grants temporary night vision.
scanner.alterna.violet_bush.title: Violet Bush
scanner.alterna.violet_bush.text: Violet bush. A hardy shrub whose leaves carry pigments tuned to the faint, reddish light that reaches the bottom of the rift. Small creatures shelter beneath its dense foliage.
scanner.alterna.white_currant.title: White Currant
scanner.alterna.white_currant.text: White currant. A low, thorny shrub bearing pale, translucent berries. The fruit is edible and rich in sugars. Tetras pick the berries in flight, and carry them back to their roosts.
scanner.alterna.star_lily.title: Star Lily
scanner.alterna.star_lily.text: Star lily. A flowering plant that clings to the walls and ledges of the rift. Its petals scatter light in a star-shaped pattern, guiding pollinators through the darkness. Cascading star lily vines often mark the edges of stable ledges.
scanner.alterna.canopra.title: Canopra Tree
scanner.alterna.canopra.text: Canopra tree. A broad-crowned tree that grows on the forested ledges of the rift. Its dense canopy traps moisture from the mist rising out of the crack, creating a humid microclimate beneath it.
scanner.alterna.goblet_tree.title: Goblet Tree
scanner.alterna.goblet_tree.text: Goblet tree. A colossal tree that grows sideways out of the rift wall, then turns upward into a funnel-shaped crown. The crown collects water into a natural pool. Its membrane tissue is sticky and elastic, and will cushion a fall.
scanner.alterna.rootshroom.title: Rootshroom
scanner.alterna.rootshroom.text: Rootshroom. A towering fungal tree, forty to seventy meters tall, with a trunk of fused root fibers. Glowing nodes within its canopy provide light far below the surface. Enoki mushrooms often grow along its stem.
scanner.alterna.enoki.title: Enoki Mushroom
scanner.alterna.enoki.text: Enoki mushroom. A slender fungus with a predatory adaptation. When a creature steps into its cluster, it slows the intruder, and then closes around it. Watch your footing near rootshroom trunks.
scanner.alterna.cloudberry.title: Cloudberry Vine
scanner.alterna.cloudberry.text: Cloudberry vine. A hanging vine that ripens into soft, luminous berries. The fruit is edible, and ripe clusters cast enough light to illuminate dark overhangs.
scanner.alterna.daze.title: Daze Grass
scanner.alterna.daze.text: Daze grass. A soft, pale grass that carpets the mossy hollows of the rift. It sways even when the air is still, a response to the faint currents rising from below.
scanner.alterna.wild_moss.title: Wild Moss
scanner.alterna.wild_moss.text: Wild moss. A thick, spongy moss that blankets damp ledges and drapes from overhangs. It holds water for long periods, sustaining the smaller plants that grow around it.
scanner.alterna.purple_sugar_cane.title: Purple Sugar Cane
scanner.alterna.purple_sugar_cane.text: Purple sugar cane. A cane adapted to the light of the rift, growing along the banks of still water. Its stalks store sugar in a deep violet sap.
scanner.alterna.vitalroot.title: Vitalroot
scanner.alterna.vitalroot.text: Vitalroot. A thick, fleshy root that pushes out through the rift walls. Its tissue is dense with stored nutrients, and it regrows readily when harvested.
